question: Which public companies filed an annual meeting proxy this week?
answer: 61 companies filed SEC Form DEF 14A (a definitive proxy statement) in the last 7 days, newest 6 Oct 2026, including Tessera Defense & Homeland Security, Xwell (XWEL), Nanoviricides (NNVC), Angiodynamics (ANGO), Siebert Financial (SIEB) and 56 more. The board holds 273, each linked to SEC EDGAR.
how: Built from the rows on this board only: company names, filing dates and counts from SEC EDGAR. Nothing written or inferred.
attribution: Free to use with credit to POPS4.

id.from: EDGAR accession number — the filing's own primary key.

company.from: Conformed company name, as the filer states it in the filing header.

cik.from: SEC Central Index Key for the filer.

form.from: SEC form type. Always 8-K on these boards.

items.from: The 8-K item numbers the FILER declared, read from the filing's .hdr.sgml <ITEMS> element.
items.note: The filer’s own label, not our classification. Boards are selections of these numbers, nothing more.

ticker.note: null when the filer has no listed ticker.

exchange.from: Exchange of record, from that same SEC file.

sector.from: The SEC's sicDescription for the filer's assigned SIC code, unmodified.
sector.note: Falls back to the filing header's ORGANIZATION-NAME when companyfacts carries none.

filerCategory.from: EDGAR filer category, e.g. "Large accelerated filer".

revenue.from: Annual revenue in USD from the filer's OWN XBRL company facts: form 10-K, FY period, most recent by period end. First match of RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, Revenues, SalesRevenueNet, RevenueFromContractWithCustomerIncludingAssessedTax.
revenue.note: null when the filer reports none under those concepts. Present on roughly 3 filers in 5.

revenueFY.from: Fiscal year of that revenue figure, from the same fact's period end.

city.from: Business address city on EDGAR, falling back to the filing header.

hq.from: Business address state on EDGAR, falling back to the filing header.
hq.note: Where the company operates. NOT the same as `state`.

formerName.from: FORMER-CONFORMED-NAME from the filer's own header.
formerName.note: Present only when the filer has actually renamed.

event.from: PERIOD from the filing header — the date of the event itself.
event.note: Deliberately separate from `filed`. They are often different days.

quote.from: One VERBATIM sentence from the filing's press-release exhibit.
quote.note: Never paraphrased, never summarised, always a whole sentence. null when the filing has no exhibit, the file exceeded our size limit, or no sentence qualified. Present on roughly 1 row in 3.

state.note: Where the company is incorporated. NOT where it operates — see `hq`.

deadline.from: COMPUTED BY US: `filed` plus 30 calendar days. Breach Clock only, null on every other board.
deadline.note: Not a date from any document. 30 is the shortest common statutory notification window; real obligations follow where affected residents live, so one breach runs several clocks.

source.from: Link to the filing's own index page on sec.gov.
source.note: Every row on these boards resolves to this document. This is the field that makes the rest checkable.

profile.from: Link to the filer's 8-K history on EDGAR.
